label-mono.purpose: Stage labels, status pills, dimension/technical readouts only — never headings or prose.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Mild lift under side panels and the card-preview frame.

shadows.name: artifact-passing-glow
shadows.purpose: Card-preview frame glow when the derived build status is passing.

motion.name: rail-pulse
motion.purpose: Highlight travels along a rail node's dot when that stage's status changes.

components.name: Stage Pill
components.description: Shared four-state status pill (pending/running/passing/failing) used by the stage-rail, each panel's local pill, and echoed by the card-preview's BUILD ARTIFACT tag.
components.css: .ds-stage-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:999px; line-height:1.6; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-stage-pill::before { content:''; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background-color:currentColor; } .ds-stage-pill--passing { color:#3fb950; background-color:color-mix(in srgb, #3fb950 16%, transparent); } .ds-stage-pill--failing { color:#f85149; background-color:color-mix(in srgb, #f85149 16%, transparent); } .ds-stage-pill--running { color:#d29922; background-color:color-mix(in srgb, #d29922 16%, transparent); } .ds-stage-pill--pending { color:#94a3b0; background-color:color-mix(in srgb, #94a3b0 16%, transparent); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one high-emphasis teal action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#2dd4bf; color:#0b0d10; padding:12px 18px; min-height:44px; border:none; border-radius:6px; font-weight:500; font-size:16px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#22b8a6; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field used across the Configure/Style/Assets panels.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; padding:10px; background:#0b0d10; color:#c9d1d9; border:1px solid #232a33; border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; transition:border-color 0.3s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#2dd4bf; outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.15); }

components.name: Stage Panel
components.description: The shared bordered surface for each pipeline stage panel.
components.css: .ds-stage-panel { background:#161b22; border:1px solid #232a33; border-radius:12px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }

components.name: Stage Rail Node
components.description: One node on the stage-rail: a pulsing status dot, a mono uppercase label, and a stage pill — three of these plus a terminus arrow form the signature pipeline widget.
components.css: .ds-rail-node { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:0.4rem; } .ds-rail-dot { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:#3fb950; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #3fb950 18%, transparent); } .ds-rail-label { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8b96a3; }

narrative.overview: GitCardX exists because GitHub ships a blank, generic social-preview card by default; this tool's own chrome earns the right to sit next to that fix by reading as technically credible rather than as a toy banner-maker. The shipped world takes that credibility literally: filling in the card's fields is framed as watching a CI run, not filling out a form. A near-black graphite base (#0b0d10 / #0d1117) reads as a terminal/dashboard surface; one teal accent (#2dd4bf) stands in for 'build/active,' used sparingly against the graphite so its rarity keeps its meaning; a four-state semantic status system (pending, running, passing, failing) drives real field validity everywhere a panel needs to say whether its own inputs are valid, not just a decorative badge scheme. JetBrains Mono is reserved for stage labels, status pills, and technical readouts (never headings or prose); Manrope carries all prose and headings.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite base with one teal accent used only for the active/build state, never as decoration
A single semantic status vocabulary (pending/running/passing/failing) reused for pills, rail nodes, and the artifact tag
JetBrains Mono strictly for stage labels, status text, and dimension/technical readouts; Manrope everywhere else
Flat, bordered surfaces on the graphite base, not shadows-as-depth
The stage-rail/stageStatusStore pairing is this build's one distinctive, product-specific pattern

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal (#2dd4bf) is the only color that means 'active/build.' It never appears as a passive background fill or a decorative flourish.

rules.name: The Single Status Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Any UI element that needs to say 'is this valid' reads its state from the same four status-* tokens and the same stageStatusStore.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono only ever labels something the pipeline metaphor treats as machine-generated output. It never sets a heading, button label, or paragraph.

rules.name: The Status-Earns-Glow Rule
rules.body: The only shadow that changes color in this system is the card-preview's passing-state glow; a shadow's color is never decorative.

dos: Do keep every validity indicator reading from stageStatusStore / the four status-* tokens.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for stage labels, status text, and technical/dimension readouts only.
Do keep the @theme and :root token names in sync when a color changes.
Do treat --border-color/--bg-color/--bg-overlay-opacity as the exported card's own theme, never app chrome.
donts: Don't use teal as a background fill or default surface color.
Don't add a second badge/status color scheme.
Don't style the exported card's inner markup (.card / #githubCard) with this design system's chrome tokens.
Don't treat Font Awesome glyph icons as an endorsed system primitive — they are an inherited, pre-redesign dependency, not part of this design system.
